infobox.usage: Unlocks the convenience store storage room on Lighthouse.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Convenience store storage room key (Store) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key that opens a storage room inside the roadside convenience store.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: The convenience store is located along the main road on Lighthouse. The storage room on the inside has a blue door.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- 1x Medcase
- 1x Dead Scav
- 1x Toolbox
- Loose loot (Meds, Medical supplies, Valuables, Provisions)
- MP-133 spawn on desk
